book.name: Matei
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Matei

content: Yecho na Yohane Mbatichajhe
Yecho pajhomolila kwapela bhabholwa bhake kome na bhabhele malaghalikilo, ajhakubhoka peniya, akajhahwii kubhola na kwatangachila bhando Malobhe gha Mbone mu miche jhibhii pahina.
Yohane Mbatichajhe pakibha mukipungo akajhohine ghala ghahengita Yecho Kilichitu. Bhahe, Yohane akabhatumite bhabholwa bhake,
bhankonye, “Bho, mwenga ndi jhola jwahika, amu tunnendele jhonge?”
Yecho ajhakwajhanguu, “Nnyendengane mukannobholele Yohane ghala ghumujhoha na kughabhona.
Bhangalola bhilola, bhubhalemile bhityanga, bhina na malohe bhilamichwa, bhangajhoha bhijhoha, bhubhawile bhiyokechwa na akahocho bhatangachilwa Lilobhe lya Mbone.
Jhuna mota mundo jhola jwanganeka kunyeketela nenga.”

Bhahe, bhabholwa bha Yohane pubhabhokita, Yecho akatumbwii kulongelela lilongo lya bhando malobhe gha Yohane, mkajhahwii kulola nike kola kunjenga? Bho, mukapaile kulinga matete ghighanyuha nyuha upepo?
Bhahe, mukajhawile kulola nike? Bho, Nnyahwila kunninga mundo jwawalite ngobho ichuluchwa kwa mbijha yamahele? Bhando bhibhahwala ngobho ya mbone utama munyumba jha unahota.
Nambo, unnobholele nike chimukajhawile kulinga? Bho, nnondole jwa Chapanga? Tela, chakaka jwenio ndi nkolongwa kupeta nnondole jwa Chapanga jhumoyobhalile.
“Yohane ndi jwalongelwa mu Majhandiko gha Chapanga, Chapanga alongila, ‘Dolokeya, nenga nintuma jumbe gwango alongolele, jwenio natengenecha ndela jhino.’

Ninobholela chakaka, pakate jha yana yoha ya bhando, anahwahi jhe kutama jwabhii nkolo kuliku Yohane Mbatichajhe. Peniya jhola jwabhii nchokombe munahota gwa kunane kwa Chapanga, ndi nkolongwa kuliku jwenio.
Kuhumii mu machiko gha Yohane Mbatichajhe ade deleno, Unahota gwa kunane kwa Chapanga ukanwa kwa makakala, na bhando bhubhabhii na bhulo na makakala bhijhigha kuupoka kwa likakala.
Mabholo ghoha gha milondole bha Chapanga na Lilaghalikilo lya Chapanga lyapekiwe Mucha ade lichiko lya Yohane, ghoha ghakalotile unahota gwa Chapanga.
Anda mihoto kujheketela ghanga, bhahe, Yohane ndi Eliya jwahika.
Jwabhii na machikilo gha kujhoha na ajhohe!
“Bhahe, nikihwananicha kibheleko chenje na kilebhe ghane? Ngita yana ikibha itamite pa liguliho, bhibhakibha bhilongehana kibhogha chimo na chenge.
‘Ahona ng'oma nambo mukina ndeka! Tujhembite mihambo jha ungolongondi nambo mukalelite jhe!’
Kwa nhwalo Yohane akahikite, ajhakupunga kulyegha anywila ndeka divaye, na bhene bhalongila, ‘Achikilwe nchuka.’

Mwana gwa Mundo akahikita, alila na kunywegha, na bhene pibhalongila, ‘Nnolokehe hojho, kuhapatika na kulobhela, nkoche jwa akatola kode na bhibhabhii na uhakaho. Nambo malango gha Chapanga ghalangiwe ndi ghambone kwa mahengo ghake.’ ”
Bhando ya miche yangajheketela
Peniya Yecho akatumbwii kwapwatalila bhando bha miche jhela jhakahengite ikangacho yamahena mwenio, bhando bhake bhakapahi ndeka kuleka uhakaho.

“Nanola choto mwa Kolazine! Nanola choto mwenga mwa Betisaida! Nhwalo ikangacho itendika kwino, ngahitendika ku Tilo na ku Sidone, kuhumii makacho bhando bhake ngabhatumbwile kuwala ngobho ya majafafa na kutama paliho kulangiya bhamujhii Chapanga!
Peniya, ninobholela, lichiko lya luhadabulo, mangota napata malagho makolongwa kuliku bhando bha ku Tilo na ku Sidone.

Mwenga, ma Kapelenaumo! Bho, namukikweya ade kunane kwa Chapanga? Oko naha ndeka, nabhahuluha ade ku kilambo cha bhando bhubhawile! Ngita ikangacho ihengika kwino ngaitendika kola ku Sodoma, muche gwenio na ngaubhii ade deleno.
Nambo ninnobholela, bhando bha ku Kapelenaumo lichiko lya luhadabulo nabhapata luhadabulo lukolongwa kuliku bhando bha ku Sodoma.”
Nhwike kwa nenga mupomolele

Machiko ghagha Yecho akalongile, “Nichengula mwe mwa Tate, Bhambo jwa kunane kwa Chapanga na pannema, kwa nhwalo mwahihite bhubhabhii na malango na bhando bhubhachomite malobhe ghanga na kwayekulila yana ichokombe.
Chakaka, Tate, ndi chimpata.
“Tate gwango ambekiye ilebhe yoha. Abhii ndeka jwaumanya Mwana nga Tate mundo, na abhii jhe jwaumanya Tate mundo nga Mwana na jhojhoha jwampahile mwana uyekulila.
“Hike kwa nenga mabhoha bhumilagha na kutotokela na mihigho, na nenga nanimpomoha.
Mukikonge lingolengole lyango, mukibhole kwa nenga, nhwalo nenga ndi natokomaho na natembekeho gwa mwojho, na nanintenda mupomolele miojho jhino.
Bhahe, lingolengole nimpela ndi lijhebhejhaho, na nhigho gwango nnyojhoho.”
